mechanism.claim: A completed daily change in Cboe VIX9D/VIX measures front-term US volatility pressure. If both BTC BVOL and DVOL move in the opposite direction during the next Cboe source date 09:00-10:00 ET hour, the external pressure has failed to transmit into crypto implied risk; BTC should move in the absorption direction for six hours.
mechanism.side: positive Cboe front-slope change plus joint crypto-vol contraction maps LONG; negative Cboe change plus joint crypto-vol expansion maps SHORT
mechanism.why_distinct: CCVDAR uses no BTC price confirmation. Prior Cboe dual-confirmation candidates used overnight and opening BTC returns; crypto-vol disagreement candidates compared BVOL with DVOL but had no Cboe pressure source.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: official Cboe-to-crypto implied-volatility disagreement at next-session 10:05 ET is absent from Gross9

features.cboe_front_change: current minus immediately previous exact Cboe observation of log(VIX9D/VIX); nonzero, no magnitude threshold
features.crypto_opening_hour: next exact Cboe source date [09:00,10:00) America/New_York
features.bvol_body: completed-hour (close-open)/open, strictly opposite Cboe change sign
features.dvol_body: completed-hour (close-open)/open, strictly opposite Cboe change sign
features.availability: Cboe observation is complete before the next source date; both crypto volatility candles complete at 10:00 ET

clock.entry: next exact Cboe source date 10:05 America/New_York

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR
